note: NECO Geography Paper III round 1: the SSCE syllabus - earth structure and rocks, weathering/erosion landforms, climate and rainfall types, vegetation belts and soils, map reading (scale, contours, eastings), population and settlement, economic geography, transport, regional geography of Nigeria (confluence, Mambilla, Jos tin, Enugu coal, Chad Basin) and environmental issues (gully erosion, desertification, gas flaring). Near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
